gate: component must be C_parent_WEP_TiPt or a declared subcomponent mapped to that slot
value must be DERIVED_ZERO or finite numeric; MISSING/PENDING/PLACEHOLDER forbidden
DERIVED_ZERO requires parent-signed zero certificate, not closure-only AX1090/MOMS assumption
numeric value requires uncertainty, units, sign convention, basis, source path, and parent_status
basis must be MTS parent WEP basis, not DD-only/external comparator basis
measured-G absorption and tau_eff=1 shortcuts cannot supply C_parent
